# Folded-Cascode OTA in SKY130 (NMOS input, cascoded NMOS mirror load)

The design is a single-stage NMOS-input folded-cascode OTA. It has one high-impedance node (vout), so the 1 pF load acts as the compensation capacitor. All bias voltages come from the 10 µA reference. These are hand-calculation estimates; I have not run the design in ngspice.

## Task 1: Design plan

### Why this topology
* **Phase margin:** a single high-impedance node gives a near-90° base. The non-dominant poles are pushed above 1 GHz.
* **Gain:** cascodes give an estimated ~59 dB against the 45 dB target.
* **Input pair:** an NMOS pair is required. With VCM = 0.9 V, a PMOS pair would need its source at about 2 V because |Vth| ≈ 1 V.
* **Bandwidth target:** GBW = gm1/(2π·C_out). For ≥150 MHz into about 1.15 pF (load plus parasitics), gm1 must be ≥ about 1.1 mS. I target about 2.1 mS, which gives roughly 290 MHz of margin.

### Signal path (node names)

| Dev | Connection (d g s b) | Role | Bias |
|---|---|---|---|
| M1 | fl vinp tail vss | input pair (+), drives left fold node | 150 µA, gm/Id≈14, W=30 L=0.3 |
| M2 | fr vinn tail vss | input pair (−), drives right fold node | 150 µA |
| MT | tail ibias vss vss | tail source, ×30 mirror of MB0 | 300 µA |
| M3/M4 | fl/fr vbp vdd vdd | PMOS fold current sources | 300 µA each |
| M5/M6 | nl/vout vbpc fl/fr (bulk = own source) | PMOS cascodes, L=0.3 to keep fold-node cap low | 150 µA each |
| M7/M8 | nl/vout vbnc nsl/nsr vss | NMOS cascodes of the mirror | 150 µA |
| M9/M10 | nsl/nsr nl vss vss | mirror (gates on nl), giving differential-to-single-ended conversion | 150 µA |

**Polarity check:** when vinp rises, I(M1) rises and the current in M5 falls. M10 then sinks less current. At the same time I(M2) falls, so M6 sources more current. Both effects push vout up, so vinp is the non-inverting input.

### Bias network (from the 10 µA reference)
* **MB0:** a diode-connected NMOS on ibias, W=2/L=0.5. It sinks IREF and sets vbn (about 0.65 V). All NMOS share the same 5 µA/µm current density, so they mirror cleanly.
* **vbp branch:** MB1 (×2, 20 µA) feeds diode-connected PMOS MPB0 (W=4 ×2, about 1.15 V Vsg), giving vbp ≈ 0.65 V. M3/M4 are 30 units at the same density, so each carries 300 µA.
* **vbpc branch:** current flows from vdd through R1 (30 kΩ) to node pcs, then through diode PMOS MPC (W=2.7 L=0.3, same density as M5/M6) to vbpc. MB2 sinks 10 µA from vbpc.
  * vbpc = 1.8 − 0.3 − Vsg ≈ 0.35 V.
  * The fold nodes then sit at about 1.5 V, so M3/M4 have Vsd ≈ 0.3 V, above their Vdsat of about 0.18 V.
* **vbnc branch:** MPB2 (vbp mirror, 10 µA) feeds vbnc, then R2 (25 kΩ), then diode NMOS MND on node nd.
  * vbnc = Vgs + 0.25 V ≈ 0.9 V.
  * M9/M10 therefore get Vds ≈ 0.2 V, which is a wide-swing low-voltage cascode mirror.

### Estimates
* **DC gain:**
  * Up side: 40 × (30 kΩ ∥ 19 kΩ) ≈ 0.46 MΩ.
  * Down side: about 3.5 MΩ.
  * Rout ≈ 0.41 MΩ, so A0 ≈ 2.1 mS × 0.41 MΩ ≈ 860, about 59 dB.
* **GBW:** about 270–290 MHz.
* **Non-dominant poles:**
  * Fold-node pole: gm5/C_fold ≈ 1.5 mS / 0.2 pF, about 1.2 GHz.
  * Mirror pole: about 1.3 GHz, and it is only a half-doublet.
  * Expected PM is about 65–70°.
* **Power:** M3 + M4 = 600 µA, bias branches = 40 µA, IREF = 10 µA. Total is about 650 µA, or about 1.17 mW (limit 2 mW).
* **Swing:** about 0.45 V to 1.3 V at the output.
* **Slew rate:** about 300 µA / 1 pF, roughly 300 V/µs.

## Task 2: Netlist

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---------------- bias generation ----------------
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5
MB1  vbp   ibias vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5 m=2
MPB0 vbp   vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=4   L=0.5 m=2
MB2  vbpc  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5
R1   vdd   pcs   30k
MPC  vbpc  vbpc  pcs  pcs pfet W=2.7 L=0.3
MPB2 vbnc  vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=4   L=0.5
R2   vbnc  nd    25k
MND  nd    nd    vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5
* ---------------- input pair + tail ----------------
MT   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5 m=30
M1   fl    vinp  tail vss nfet W=5   L=0.3 m=6
M2   fr    vinn  tail vss nfet W=5   L=0.3 m=6
* ---------------- PMOS folding sources ----------------
M3   fl    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=4   L=0.5 m=30
M4   fr    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=4   L=0.5 m=30
* ---------------- PMOS cascodes ----------------
M5   nl    vbpc  fl   fl  pfet W=5   L=0.3 m=8
M6   vout  vbpc  fr   fr  pfet W=5   L=0.3 m=8
* ---------------- NMOS cascoded mirror load ----------------
M7   nl    vbnc  nsl  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5 m=15
M8   vout  vbnc  nsr  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5 m=15
M9   nsl   nl    vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5 m=15
M10  nsr   nl    vss  vss nfet W=2   L=0.5 m=15
.ends
```
